description: Jest 30.5.2's text for a node:assert deepStrictEqual and deepEqual under --expand (jest-circus `formatNodeAssertErrors` reads `state.expand`): the whole diff, not the changed lines with context. The objects are long enough that the two differ. Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a test list line (those carry durations), a time, a count line or runner noise. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-node-assert.test.ts`.

run.keepLines: ^(?!\s+at )(?!ERROR: failed)(?!\(node:)(?!\(Use )(?!\s+✕)(?!\s+(?:inside a describe|nested)$)(?!\s+>?\s*\d+ \|)(?!\s+\| +\^)(?!Time:)(?!Ran all)(?!Test Suites:)(?!Tests:)(?!Snapshots:)(?!Test results)(?!\s*$)
